entities.summary: Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith is a public university located in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India. Established on 10 February 1921 as Kashi Vidyapith and later renamed, it is administered under the state legislature of the government of Uttar Pradesh. It got University status in 1974 as Deemed to be University and State University status in 2009 by The Uttar Pradesh State Universities (Amendment) Act, 2008. The university has more than 400+ affiliated colleges spread over six districts. It is one of the largest state universities in Uttar Pradesh, with hundreds of thousands of students, both rural and urban.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Established in 1921 as a pioneering institution of modern education in India, Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapeeth has played a significant role in shaping the country's educational landscape, with over 400 affiliated colleges and hundreds of thousands of students.
